reason: Every cell keeps the reference design: the pale-faced blue flame with dark outline and trailing flame tongues, in the same colours and proportions. The idles visibly move (flames rise and fall, body bobs), the attack is a clear stretched forward lunge unlike the squinting hit recoil, and dead is a flat, closed-eyed heap; the art is crisp with no fringe or clipping. Minor nitpick: the attack is only a dash pose with no extra flare or effect, so it reads a little weaker than it could.
